newsitem.title: UK: Gilt futures set new all-time high after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Gilt futures set new all-time high after U.S. data.

text.p: March gilt futures set a new high for any gilt contract on LIFFE shooting above 112-23 after U.S. payroll data gave European markets a lift.
The new high surpassed the 112-17 high set on continuation charts in January and December 1996.
At 1338 GMT, the March contract was at 112-24, up 19/32 on the day.
The data showed payrolls rose to 271,000 in January compared with forecasts of 237,000 and versus 262,000 in December.
The unemployment rate rose slightly to 5.4 pct compared with an expected rate of 5.2 percent. In December the rate was 5.3 percent.
The hours worked in a week declined to 34.1 hours versus forecasts of 34.6 hours and 34.8 hours in December.
Hourly earnings rose to $12.06 from $12.05 previously.
